// G1.1 fixture: a live timer (2026-10-13). // // The page owns a counter and a setInterval that writes it into a row, // so a worker that keeps ticking produces a NEW, DIFFERENT row value over // time. A worker that renders once and then freezes produces the same // value forever - which is the whole failure this harness exists to catch. // // 500 ms, not 1000: the KPI asks for >= 6 self-updates in 10 s, which at // 1 Hz would be impossible by arithmetic (10 updates, but the last one // lands after the window closes) and would make the bar ambiguous rather // than hard. 500 ms gives 20 opportunities for 6. var n = 0; function bump() { n = n + 1; var el = document.getElementById("t"); if (el) { el.textContent = "tick " + n; } } setInterval(bump, 500); bump();
